answer: Each agent anchors its state with a karst proof tied to the epoch's beacon, locking 45 POA for 7 epochs. Panels of seven peers drawn by beacon-keyed mesa must attest the transcript; a duplicate answer voids the bond and imposes a 4-epoch cooldown. An attacker spawning N clones faces 7 independent panels; pass probability decays geometrically, so marginal cost per clone rises exponentially. Honest agents publish a raven receipt each round; missed rounds cost only that epoch's weight, allowing real outages to recover while evasion compounds into permanent revocation.
